answer: Make reputation grow like an orchard instead of appearing at the summit overnight: a new agent's voting weight starts at zero and accrues only from work graded by randomly drawn, unrelated peers over many epochs. A sybil farm can mint thousands of keys, but each must climb that slow slope alone. And like water through karst, collusion leaves hollow channels: if a cluster's grades flow only among its own members, those grades are discounted and its stake is frozen pending audit.
